{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Inspect the data
print(df.info())
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(df.head())

# Check for QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999999.99'
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()

print(f'\nNumber of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {qa_count}')

# Check their status
qa_status = df[qa_mask]['status'].value_counts()
print(f'QA orders status breakdown:\n{qa_status}')

# Count completed and refunded orders, excluding QA orders
non_qa_df = df[~qa_mask]
completed_non_qa = non_qa_df['status'].eq('completed').sum()
refunded_non_qa = non_qa_df['status'].eq('refunded').sum()

print(f'\nCompleted orders (excluding QA): {completed_non_qa}')
print(f'Refunded orders (excluding QA): {refunded_non_qa}')
print(f'Total non-QA rows: {len(non_qa_df)}')

# Confirm total matches
assert completed_non_qa + refunded_non_qa == len(non_qa_df), "Total count mismatch after excluding QA"

# Output the completed count (excluding QA)
completed_non_qa"}
